prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. Animals in pairs walk side by side up a dusty hillside path toward the hilltop, two camels, two oxen and two goats one pair behind another, and a few small figures in silhouette stand aside on the slope watching them pass. Evening, warm low sun and long shadows. Ordered and strange. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
